svg.title: Four engineering lanes
svg.desc: Data engineering: ingestion and cleaning pipelines, SQLite and Parquet stores, make-driven rebuilds and pytest validation. Data science: composite indices, lead-lag correlation, SHAP-explained models, geospatial analysis and what-if simulation. Applied AI: hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, vector search and transformer text classification with token-level explanations. Agentic systems: policy-gated tool chains with retries, human escalation and audit logs behind FastAPI back ends and React, Next.js or Streamlit front ends.
